CLOCKYN TUTORIAL VIDEO LIST
===========================
28 videos for people who have never used Clockyn. Not one video per FAQ: each video answers the one question
a new Admin or Employee asks at that moment. Make them with the skill "clockyn-screen-video" (SKILL.md in this folder).

HOW TO USE THIS FILE (for Copilot)
- The user picks videos by ID (for example "make V07"). Make ONE video per request, never all at once.
- Use the TITLE as config.json "question" (it is also the Video Hub name). Use SLUG as config.json "slug".
- The FLOW lines are a storyboard, not final wording. BEFORE writing narration, read the real screens
  (src/features/<feature>/screens, e2e/specs) and use the exact labels and testIDs that exist. If the real
  app differs from the FLOW, follow the real app and tell the user.
- Keep each video 20 to 30 seconds, 3 steps (4 at most), one question, one outcome.
- ROLE = the role to log in as in the recording (loginAs): admin | manager | staff | fieldStaff.
- CAN RECORD: yes = plain app screens; partly = something in the flow cannot be shown in the web build
  (camera, GPS, payment gateway, push notification, OS permission pop-ups): show everything up to that point, narrate
  the rest, and say what is missing in the hand-over; no = needs a real phone, skip until the user asks.
- STATUS: DONE (file exists), REQUESTED (user already asked Copilot for it), TODO.
- Videos are for the Video Hub (web console > Video Hub > Upload video, MP4 up to 500 MB, name up to 150 chars).

SUGGESTED ORDER (what a new company needs first)
  Week 1 (set up):        V01 V02 V03 V04 V05 V06 V07
  Week 1 (employees):     V16 V17 V18 V19
  Week 2 (daily use):     V08 V09 V10 V20 V21 V22
  Week 3 (pay, CRM, chat): V11 V12 V13 V14 V15 V23 V24 V25 V26
  Week 4 (plans, help):   V27 V28


=============================================================================================
PART 1 - ADMIN (owner / HR): set up the company and run it
=============================================================================================

--- Get started ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

V01  How do I register my company and log in to Clockyn?
     SLUG: register-and-login     WHO: Admin     ROLE: new user     LENGTH: ~28 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: Open app > Admin Portal > enter e-mail > Get OTP > enter the 6-digit code > (new e-mail) Register
           Company: company name, address, state, district, pincode, first branch > finish > Home opens.
           Mention the 1-month free trial.
     CAN RECORD: yes (mock OTP is 123456; register a fresh e-mail)     STATUS: TODO

V02  What is on the Home screen and what do the bottom tabs do?
     SLUG: home-tour     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~25 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: Home: today's attendance cards (present, late, working) > Quick Actions (Staff Location, View Reports,
           Requests) > Manage cards (Staff, Branches, Departments) > bottom tabs: Home, CRM, Chat, Settings, Support.
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

V03  How do I add my branches and departments?
     SLUG: add-branch-department     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~25 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: Home > Manage > Branches "+ Add" (name, address, map location, radius) > save > Departments "+ Add" > save.
           Say why: staff are assigned to a branch and department, and punch-in is checked against the branch location.
     CAN RECORD: yes (map tiles are stubbed in the web build: narrate, do not zoom on the map)     STATUS: TODO

V04  How do I add a new staff member?
     SLUG: faq-add-staff     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     STATUS: DONE
     FILES: C:\POC\clockyn_faq_videos\faq-add-staff-v2.mp4 (has the old look: FAQ label, no watermark; re-render if wanted)

V05  How do I add a manager and choose what they can do?
     SLUG: add-manager-permissions     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~28 s     PRIORITY: P2
     FLOW: Settings > Managers > Add > name, phone, branch scope > pick permissions (for example Requests, Reports)
           > save > open the manager and show the permission list. Say: a manager only sees what you allow.
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

V06  How do I set up shifts, weekly offs and holidays?
     SLUG: shifts-offs-holidays     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~30 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: Settings > Shifts > Add New Shift (name, start time, end time) > Assign Staff > Off Days (for example Sunday)
           > Holidays > Add Holiday (name, date) > save.
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

V07  How do I decide when an employee is marked late or absent?
     SLUG: attendance-rules     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~25 s     PRIORITY: P2
     FLOW: Settings > Attendance Rule > Late Punch-In Count, Punch Allowed / No Punch / Block Attendance options >
           save. Explain each option in plain words (what the employee will see).
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

--- Daily attendance ----------------------------------------------------------------------

V08  How do I see who is present, late or absent today?
     SLUG: todays-attendance     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~22 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: Home attendance cards (Present, Late Punched-In, Working, Absent) > tap a card to open the list > open one
           employee to see punch times. Optional: Staff Location (live map; needs the Elite plan).
     CAN RECORD: yes (map is stubbed)     STATUS: TODO

V09  How do I check employee attendance and download a report?
     SLUG: check-attendance-download-report     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     STATUS: DONE
     FILES: C:\POC\clockyn_faq_videos\check-attendance-download-report.mp4

V10  How do I approve or reject leave, permission and shift-change requests?
     SLUG: approve-requests     WHO: Admin / Manager     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~28 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: Home > Quick Actions > Requests (red badge = pending) > pick a type (Leave, Permission, Shift Change,
           Device Change) > open a request > Approve (or Reject with a reason) > status changes. Mention that the
           employee gets the result.
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

--- Pay and expenses ----------------------------------------------------------------------

V11  How do I set up salary for my staff?
     SLUG: setup-salary     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~30 s     PRIORITY: P2
     FLOW: Reports/Payroll > pick a pay type (monthly, daily wages or hourly) > create a wage template > assign it to
           staff > View Staff Salary (salary sheet) to check.
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

V12  How do I see monthly salary and download it?
     SLUG: monthly-salary-download     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~25 s     PRIORITY: P2
     FLOW: Reports > Salary Reports > Monthly Salary > choose month > see each employee's payable amount > Export >
           Download as Excel.
     CAN RECORD: yes (the download shows no message in the browser; end on the table)     STATUS: TODO

V13  How do I create and share payslips?
     SLUG: payslips     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~28 s     PRIORITY: P2
     FLOW: Payroll > Payslips > create payslip (earnings, deductions) > assign to staff > employee sees it under Payslip.
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

V14  How do I add a bonus, an advance or an incentive?
     SLUG: bonus-advance-incentive     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~25 s     PRIORITY: P3
     FLOW: Payroll > Bonus / Advance > pick staff > amount and note > save > it shows in that month's salary.
           Then Incentive and Overtime in one sentence each.
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

V15  How do I review my team's expense claims?
     SLUG: review-expenses     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~25 s     PRIORITY: P3
     FLOW: Expenses > Bills / Travel / Odometer > open a claim > approve or reject.
     CAN RECORD: yes (receipt photos are placeholders)     STATUS: TODO

=============================================================================================
PART 2 - EMPLOYEE (staff): first day to daily use
=============================================================================================
Employee screens open only in the Android / iOS app in production. In the web build used for recording the
e2e build turns them on (EXPO_PUBLIC_ALLOW_WEB_EMPLOYEE=true). Do not show a browser address bar.

V16  How do I log in to Clockyn as an employee for the first time?
     SLUG: employee-first-login     WHO: Employee     ROLE: none (login screen)     LENGTH: ~25 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: Install the app > Employee Access > enter the mobile number your company added > OTP > Home opens.
           Say: if the number is not accepted, ask the admin to add you.
     CAN RECORD: yes (mock OTP 123456)     STATUS: TODO

V17  How do I set up my face for attendance?
     SLUG: setup-face     WHO: Employee     ROLE: staff     LENGTH: ~28 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: Home > Register Face > allow camera > look at the camera in good light > capture > success message.
           Say why: your face is your punch-in.
     CAN RECORD: partly (the web build uses a fake camera; show the screens and the success state)
     STATUS: REQUESTED (user asked Copilot)

V18  How do I punch in and punch out?
     SLUG: punch-in-out     WHO: Employee     ROLE: staff     LENGTH: ~28 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: Home > Punch In > face check + location check > "Punched in" with the time > later Punch Out > day total
           shown. Say: you must be at your branch location.
     CAN RECORD: partly (fake camera and fixed location; the real GPS and face match cannot be shown)
     STATUS: REQUESTED (user asked Copilot)

V19  What if punch-in does not work? (location, camera and permission fixes)
     SLUG: fix-punch-in-problems     WHO: Employee     ROLE: staff     LENGTH: ~28 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: Settings > App Permissions > Camera, Location, Notifications > "Open Settings" to switch them on >
           come back and punch in again. Also: face not recognised -> re-register face; wrong branch -> ask admin.
           Do not film OS pop-ups (not possible); show the in-app permission screen only.
     CAN RECORD: partly     STATUS: TODO

V20  How do I check my own attendance for the month?
     SLUG: my-attendance     WHO: Employee     ROLE: staff     LENGTH: ~22 s     PRIORITY: P2
     FLOW: Home > Attendance Calendar > pick month > tap a day to see punch times > colours (present, late, leave, holiday).
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

V21  How do I apply for leave or permission?
     SLUG: apply-leave-permission     WHO: Employee     ROLE: staff     LENGTH: ~28 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: More > Requests > New Request > Leave Request (dates, reason) > Submit > My Requests shows Pending.
           Then say: Permission and Shift Change work the same way.
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

V22  I got a new phone. How do I move my account?
     SLUG: new-phone-device-change     WHO: Employee     ROLE: none (login screen)     LENGTH: ~25 s     PRIORITY: P2
     FLOW: Login on the new phone > "this device is not registered" message > Device Change Request > reason > submit >
           admin approves (show in V10) > log in again.
     CAN RECORD: yes (mock has a device-change flow)     STATUS: TODO

V23  Where do I see my payslip, salary and advances?
     SLUG: my-payslip     WHO: Employee     ROLE: staff     LENGTH: ~22 s     PRIORITY: P3
     FLOW: Settings or More > Payslip > month > earnings and deductions > Bonus / Advance list.
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

V24  How do I submit an expense or travel claim?
     SLUG: submit-expense     WHO: Employee     ROLE: staff / fieldStaff     LENGTH: ~28 s     PRIORITY: P3
     FLOW: More > Expenses > Bills (amount, photo) or Travel / Odometer > submit > status Pending.
     CAN RECORD: partly (photo capture is a fake image)     STATUS: TODO

=============================================================================================
PART 3 - CRM AND CHAT (admin and employees)
=============================================================================================

V25  How do I add leads and give them to my team?
     SLUG: crm-leads     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~30 s     PRIORITY: P2
     FLOW: CRM tab > Add lead (name, phone, category) > save > Assign To (staff) > status choices (new, contacted,
           interested, converted, not interested). Say how employees then see it in their CRM tab.
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

V26  How do I chat with my team and send an announcement?
     SLUG: chat-and-announcements     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~30 s     PRIORITY: P2
     FLOW: Chat tab > open a staff member and send a message > Groups: create a group > Announcements: write a message
           and choose everyone, a branch, a department or selected staff > send. Employees see it in their Chat tab.
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

=============================================================================================
PART 4 - PLANS, PAYMENTS AND HELP (admin)
=============================================================================================

V27  How do I upgrade my plan and pay, and where are my invoices?
     SLUG: upgrade-plan-invoices     WHO: Admin     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~30 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: Settings > Your Plan & Validity (trial end date, staff limit) > Buy a Plan > choose a plan > coupon (optional)
           > Pay > success > Billing History > download invoice.
     CAN RECORD: partly (the payment window is stubbed in the web build: stop at "Pay", narrate the rest, end on the
           invoice list)     STATUS: TODO

V28  Where do I get help? (FAQ, videos, live chat and feature requests)
     SLUG: get-help-support     WHO: Admin and Employee     ROLE: admin     LENGTH: ~25 s     PRIORITY: P1
     FLOW: Support tab > FAQ (search "attendance", open an answer) > Videos > Live Chat (send a message) > Suggest a
           Feature. Say: these help pages and these videos are always in the Support tab.
     CAN RECORD: yes     STATUS: TODO

LATER / ONLY IF ASKED (do not make now)
=============================================================================================
  - Staff Location live map and field-staff trail (needs real GPS data)
  - Overtime and count-basis / turnover payroll types in detail
  - Reports in detail: Late Report, Overtime Report, Employee Shifts report, Employee Details
  - Company profile edit, theme (Light / Dark / System), account deletion request, privacy policy
  - Bulk staff import, multiple companies
  - Anything that needs a real phone: push notifications, biometric lock, real payment, real GPS, OS permission pop-ups

CHECKLIST BEFORE HANDING OVER ANY VIDEO
  [ ] Narration uses the exact on-screen labels   [ ] 20 to 30 s, 3 steps   [ ] Stills checked frame by frame
  [ ] Watermark and (empty) top-right label as set in config.json   [ ] Temporary recording spec deleted
  [ ] Said what was not shown (partly-recordable parts) and that the audio was not listened to
